name: Maria
source:
One of the girls working for the sex industry as a hostess or fuuzokujou. Maria her pseudonym and she is one year older than [url=/c99739]Ayako[/url]. She has three years of industry experience and she is very skilled at her job. Maria takes good care of the other hostesses like an elder sister. Her downside is an alcohol addiction and the habit of relieving stress by shopping for branded goods. [spoiler]Maria is traumatized when it comes to men and is not into dating. [/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20060207232233/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/hansoku.htm]Official Website[/url].]
